source_apk: Original Play-installed com.nextai.game.offline v9/1.2, previously pulled from A07
table_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `games` (`name` TEXT NOT NULL, `title` TEXT NOT NULL, `category` TEXT NOT NULL, `position` INTEGER NOT NULL, `soundToggleType` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `configType` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `useWideViewPortAndOverviewMode` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `leaderboardId` TEXT, `section` TEXT, `has_rewarded_video` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `each_n_seconds` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 180, `each_n_levels` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, `each_n_scores` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 500, `minimum_level` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `minimum_time_played_in_game_sec` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, `gameFinishedAd` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `js_popup_each_n_seconds` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 120, `remote_image_url` TEXT, `remote_url_version` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `remote_url` TEXT, `size_mb` REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `isHorizontal` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `icon` TEXT, `is_downloaded` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(`name`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `banners` (`gameId` TEXT NOT NULL, `position` INTEGER NOT NULL, `image_url` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`gameId`, `position`), FOREIGN KEY(`gameId`) REFERENCES `games`(`name`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_game_stats` (`game_name` TEXT NOT NULL, `high_score` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `games_played` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `total_time_spent_sec` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `is_favorite` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `last_played` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`game_name`), FOREIGN KEY(`game_name`) REFERENCES `games`(`name`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `offline_games_interstitial` (`version` INTEGER NOT NULL, `url` TEXT NOT NULL, `actionUrl` TEXT NOT NULL, `showDailyLimit` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, PRIMARY KEY(`version`))
